connector.name: XMemo
connector.registryDescription: User-owned memory for AI agents, Copilot, Claude, IDEs, CLIs, and chat apps over remote MCP.
connector.summary: Hosted at xmemo.dev over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the yonro account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token issued by XMemo; send as an Authorization Bearer value.

headers.name: X-Memory-OS-Agent-ID
headers.description: Optional stable agent family id for attribution, for example 'claude-code' or 'copilot-cli'.

headers.name: X-Memory-OS-Agent-Instance-ID
headers.description: Optional stable local installation id for attribution; XMemo hashes it server-side.

headers.name: X-Memory-OS-Device-ID
headers.description: Optional stable local device id for attribution; use a non-secret machine/install identifier.

headers.name: X-Memory-OS-Device-Label
headers.description: Optional human-readable local device label for attribution, for example 'MacBook Pro' or 'PC A'.
